description.value: Qualicum Beach Inn is a 32-room oceanside hotel situated directly beside Qualicum's longest sandy beach and a seawall park on Vancouver Island. Formerly the Old Dutch Inn, the property was fully renovated in 2015 into a boutique-style hotel with most rooms offering views of the Strait of Georgia and private patio or balcony access. A touring cyclist finishing a day on the Island Highway will find the hotel just steps from the beach with an on-site restaurant, lounge, heated indoor pool, hot tub, and sauna.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed amenity information. The pet-friendly room subpage confirms free WiFi, an on-site Restaurant and Lounge, heated indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness room, and free parking. No mention of bike-specific facilities (storage, tools, pump, wash, charging) appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null. The About page explicitly lists 'Qualicum Foods - Quality Foods' under a 'Groceries' heading, confirming a nearby grocery option, and the on-site Restaurant and Lounge confirms nearby evening food.
concerns: Minor address formatting difference: OSM has '2690 West Island Highway' while the website footer reads '2690 Island Highway West' — same location, different word order.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating oceanfront hotel with a live booking system, confirmed open as of copyright 2025. Clearly useful to touring cyclists on the Island Highway.
enrichment_extras.notes: Hotel notes 'stairs to upper level, no elevator' — relevant for cyclists with heavy loaded bikes seeking ground-floor access. Dog-friendly rooms available, which may appeal to cycle-tourists travelling with pets.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Restaurant and Lounge; website states 'Arrange a reservation with the front desk.'

Nearby grocery.detail: About page lists 'Qualicum Foods - Quality Foods' under a dedicated 'Groceries' heading as a nearby option
